name: test-coverage-review-fe
description: Use before merging a change to the Next.js frontend, or when asked "does this component have adequate tests?". Read-only reviewer that judges whether a diff carries meaningful tests against this repo's model (colocated *.test.tsx, stories-as-fixtures via composeStories, RTL user-facing queries, Playwright e2e/, ≥90% gate). Reports a PASS / CHANGES-REQUESTED verdict with concrete gaps; never edits, stages, or runs the app.
